title: Photos libraries
whyItMatters: A Photos library can hold years of personal photographs and videos. Its size and location show how much visual history stays on the Mac.
source: Apple Support: Photos Library is stored by default in the Pictures folder - https://support.apple.com/guide/photos/photo-library-overview-pht211de786/mac
notes: No recursion: size comes from the library package's own metadata, never its contents. Libraries moved off ~/Pictures are not matched.
